answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is cryptographically bound to an enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, verified through a trusted Intel SGX or AMD SEV remote-attestation chain. A nebula, cipher, or falcon-themed software clone cannot mint another valid identity: reproducing the binding requires acquiring and provisioning distinct physical silicon with an accepted measurement, making Sybil expansion costly rather than achievable through virtual-machine duplication.
